jobs.title: Corporate Counsel
jobs.description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own. We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full. How you'll make impact As Corporate Counsel, you’ll support Airwallex’s growth in the UK by providing practical, business-focused legal advice on corporate, regulatory and commercial matters. You’ll work closely with Corporate Development on strategic transactions such as fundraising and M&A, partner with UK and regional leaders on new-market entry, support licence expansion, and help align Airwallex’s global policies and governance with UK and relevant EMEA requirements. You’ll also advise on marketing, referral and partnership initiatives, helping the business move quickly while managing legal and regulatory risk. Provide clear, pragmatic advice on UK and relevant EMEA legal and regulatory requirements, helping teams navigate applicable rules while enabling responsible growth. Support Corporate Development on fundraising rounds and strategic transactions, including due diligence, data rooms, corporate approvals, investment documentation, cap table changes and ongoing governance. jobs.description: About Relation Relation is a sector defining TechBio company developing transformational medicines, with technology at our core. Our ambition is to understand human biology in unprecedented ways, discovering therapies to treat some of life’s most devastating diseases. We leverage single-cell multi-omics from patient tissue, functional assays, and machine learning to drive disease understanding, from cause to cure. We are scaling rapidly and building a team of exceptional individuals to push the boundaries of drug discovery. You will work in highly interdisciplinary teams where biology, computation, and engineering come together to solve complex problems that have not been solved before. Our state-of-the-art wet and dry labs in the heart of London are designed to accelerate this integration and translate insight into impact. We are committed to building diverse and inclusive teams. Relation is an equal opportunities employer and does not discriminate on the basis of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, disability, or age. By joining Relation, you will help define how medicines are discovered and deliver meaningful impact for patients. The opportunity Relation is offering an outstanding opportunity for an experienced Project Manager to work in close partnership with our Programme and Project Leaders, putting you in a prime position to help shape delivery plans and drive our osteoporosis programme forward. Working across the full discovery journey, you'll help move the programme through Target ID, Hit-to-Lead, Lead Optimisation, Candidate Selection and beyond — coordinating across the multiple projects that make up the programme, our internal interdisciplinary teams, and third-party partners such as CROs, all while navigating the ambiguity of discovery-stage science with confidence. Focussed on client outcomes, seasoned experts lead every engagement, in an operating model powered by AI and free from audit conflict. You'll run a portfolio of client engagements, from single-asset claims through to large multi-site capital expenditure projects, working across all sectors. You'll support the technical lead on claims, act as the main point of contact for clients, and drive growth in this part of the practice. This is a genuine opportunity to shape how the team operates, not slot into an existing one. Unity's technology and AI tools handle the heavy lifting on claim preparation and data analysis, freeing you up for the technical judgement and client relationships that actually move the needle. Prepare, review and submit capital allowances claims, ensuring technical accuracy and compliance with current legislation. jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Startups (Codex)
jobs.description: About the team The Applied AI Engineering team works closely with frontier startups. We are trusted advisors to, and thought partners with, startups to ensure that OpenAI’s technology is deployed safely and effectively, whilst also partnering with engineering, research, and product to turn those insights into evaluation systems, product improvements, and better model behavior. This team sits at the intersection of customer reality and model quality. We combine hands-on technical depth with strong product judgment, helping translate complex, high-value use cases into clear signals that can improve both the customer experience and the underlying systems. About the Role As an Applied AI Engineer focused on Codex for startups, you will help developers and founders transform how they build and ship software. You’ll combine hands-on engineering, startup experience, and compelling technical communication to help teams turn the potential of AI coding tools into practical, effective workflows. Presentations and community engagement are central to this role. You will engage developers and founders through technical talks, live demos, workshops, and programmes across the startup ecosystem, alongside targeted work with individual customers. You’ll build reusable tools and resources that extend your impact, and bring insights from developers back to OpenAI’s Product, Research, and Engineering teams. This role is well suited to someone who enjoys both hands-on building and sharing what they learn with others. You should be as excited to lead a room of developers, deliver an engaging presentation, and build relationships across the startup community as you are to explore a technical problem in code—with a focus on sustained adoption and meaningful improvements in how startups work. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Fraud and regulation are rising, costing the UK economy over £100bn every year; this makes it more difficult for businesses to protect themselves and their clients - individuals like you and me - from fraud and money laundering. Our co-founders Olly and Jack were led to this area when a friend was defrauded of £25K when buying their first property. At the time, anti-fraud technology didn’t exist, which meant that completing the anti-fraud checks required in these processes was largely manual. These big life moments should be exciting, but instead are often confusing and scary due to the painful process of completing these paper-based checks and the risk of fraud. Thirdfort helps businesses to facilitate these anti fraud checks so that individuals know they can transact safely and seamlessly with professionals during these big transactions. Our anti-fraud platform provides a secure way for professionals in regulated sectors like Lawyers, Estate Agents and Accountants to transfer funds and verify sensitive information through app based document checks, facial recognition and open banking. Over 1,500 businesses now trust Thirdfort to verify their clients. We are FCA regulated and have raised over \$33m in capital from leading Fintech investors Breega and Element Ventures, as well as the founders of Zoopla, Funding Circle, Comply Advantage, Tessian, Fenergo and Fidel. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex problems , owning technical direction within a domain, and helping other engineers grow through mentorship and example. jobs.title: Federal Climate Policy Director
jobs.description: Pacific Environment is a nonprofit organization dedicated to confronting our most urgent environmental issues by connecting local and global movements, catalyzing policy change, and inspiring action for the benefit of people and our planet. Together, we promote a healthy climate, reduce pollution, and conserve biodiversity for an equitable and thriving future. Learn more at www.pacificenvironment.org . Building on more than thirty years of policy wins for the Pacific Rim's peoples, ecosystems, and climate, Pacific Environment has been campaigning to end fossil fuel use, including to get ships off fossil fuels. Our federal strategies include securing strong regulatory frameworks and legislation to achieve zero-emission shipping on a timeline commensurate with the climate emergency; mobilizing congressional and public pressure on federal agencies and policymakers to adopt binding emissions standards and public investments; and engaging industry and maritime workers as partners in the transition to zero-emission shipping — working with bodies such as the U.S. Coast Guard, MARAD, and the Federal Maritime Commission to align national maritime policy with a zero-emission shipping future. Position Pacific Environment seeks an experienced Federal Policy Director to lead the organization's federal government affairs strategy on maritime shipping issues. This role is the organization's principal advocate before Congress and federal agencies — including the U.S. Coast Guard, Maritime Administration (MARAD), Federal Maritime Commission (FMC), EPA, and Department of Transportation — on policy priorities such as vessel emissions and fuel standards, port and vessel infrastructure investment, supply chain resilience, and maritime workforce and safety standards. We are proud to be a  Unicorn  company—privately valued at over $1 billion—demonstrating strong growth, innovation, and lasting impact in our industry. Together, we’re shaping the future of workplace communication. This is a hands-on technical role within Staffbase Build, responsible for turning specific enterprise customer needs into reliable, scalable extensions of the Staffbase platform, using its extensibility capabilities (widgets, plugins, integrations, and other platform objects). The role owns assigned customer solutions end-to-end, defining the use case with stakeholders, building and testing across the stack, deploying it, and validating it with users. jobs.title: Elektriker (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft der Chipindustrie – von Anfang an! Deine Rolle bei Black Semiconductor Bei Black Semiconductor entwickeln wir eine neue Generation der Halbleitertechnologie. Mit unserer ersten Produktionsanlage FabOne in Aachen schaffen wir die Grundlage für die Chipfertigung der Zukunft. Dafür suchen wir dich! Als Elektriker*in wirst du Teil unseres Facility-Teams und unterstützt den Aufbau, die Inbetriebnahme und den Betrieb der elektrotechnischen Infrastruktur unserer Produktionsanlage. Über uns Wir verstehen die Halbleiterindustrie als ein Universum voller Möglichkeiten. Wir erkennen Chancen und sehen das transformative Potenzial, das unsere Graphen-Lösungen für die Neugestaltung der Branche mit sich bringen. Wir laden Dich ein, diesen Wandel gemeinsam mit uns voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Diese Vision ist es, zu zeigen, dass grundlegende Veränderungen möglich sind. Mit Deinem Wissen und Deinen Fähigkeiten kannst Du beweisen, dass Dinge anders – und besser – gemacht werden können. Gemeinsam haben wir die Kraft, das Paradigma zu verändern, wie die Welt vernetzt ist. Unsere Technology Die steigenden Anforderungen der Halbleiterindustrie an leistungsfähigere Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Energieverbrauch werden durch unsere Technologie adressiert. Wir ermöglichen die Verbindung von Chips mit Hochdurchsatz-Computernetzwerken bei minimaler Latenz. Der entscheidende Faktor ist die Nutzung der einzigartigen physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu vereinen. Dadurch können unzählige Chips miteinander interagieren, als wären sie ein einziges System. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation hebt Rechenleistung und Effizienz auf ein neues Niveau. Kurz gesagt: Wir vernetzen Chips zu leistungsstarken, energieeffizienten Systemen und überwinden mit unserer Graphen-Technologie die bisherigen Grenzen der Konnektivität in der Halbleiter

jobs.title: Software Engineer Intern - Robotics Platform
jobs.description: Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots. Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment. Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry. The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously. About the role At Gravis, we build high tech systems that give machine operators superhuman capabilities. To adapt in real time to changes in the environment the Gravis Rack fuses data from LiDAR, cameras, GNSS, and hydraulics into an autonomous control system. The robotics platform team builds the software foundation for our robots to enable non stop operation in the harshest environments. We ensure all algorithms execute correctly, based on a rock solid communication layer and world class introspection capabilities. We provide all the tools to deploy, develop and debug the most powerful robots on earth. As a robotics platform software engineer intern, you will help build our vision of a scalable, safe and high performing robotics platform. You will gather requirements from internal customers, work on communication layer, node orchestration and lifecycle management as well as APIs to off-machine systems. Working with core technologies including Python, PHP, Kafka, PostgreSQL, and ClickHouse, you will design scalable, highly available systems that transform raw maritime telemetry into real-time actionable insights for global shipping and commodity markets. jobs.title: Research Scientist – Foundation Models and Multimodal AI
jobs.description: About us Owkin is an agentic AI company pioneering Biological Artificial Superintelligence to solve problems in biology where human researchers alone have failed. Owkin builds K Pro - an AI scientist for pharmaceutical research and strategic decision-making. K Pro orchestrates a suite of AI skills and tools to decode complex biology, accelerate research, and dramatically increase productivity. K Pro is built on Owkin’s unrivalled multimodal patient data network, state-of-the-art AI for biology and a decade of experience working with pharmaceutical partners. Position is based in our Paris office or remotely in France, UK, Germany. Please submit your CV in English About the role: We are seeking a driven Research Scientist with hands-on expertise in Foundation Models (FMs) and Multimodal AI to help drive the next phase of our machine learning platform. In this role, you will bridge cutting-edge AI research and practical application. Rather than training massive base models from scratch, your focus will be on fine-tuning, adapting, and aligning open-weights foundation models across diverse data modalities (e.g. structured tabular data, single-cell scRNA-seq, image representations, and natural language) to build multimodal systems. In particular, you will be responsible for: Model adaptation and optimization: Adapt, fine-tune, and evaluate state-of-the-art open-source foundation models (e.g., domain-specific transformers, vision-language models) using fine-tuning and transfer learning strategies. Multimodal integration: Design and implement cross-modal alignment architectures (e.g., contrastive learning, projection heads, unified embedding spaces) to fuse structured, sequential, and text/image data layers. Pipeline and evaluation engineering: Build rigorous, domain-tailored benchmarking frameworks and evaluation pipelines to validate model reliability, generalization, and downstream task performance. jobs.title: Senior People Partner
jobs.description: Senior People Partner Cloudscaler | London | People Team | Reports to the Chief People Officer | £55,000–£75,000 Someone has to own the People initiative that doesn’t fit neatly into anyone’s week and the case nobody else should be handling. That someone is you — not as an escalation point, but as the person who runs the day-to-day of this function. THE MOMENT Cloudscaler is 130 people today. We’ll be 170 by the end of this year, and roughly double again in 2027. The People function is being built in real time alongside that growth, rather than inherited from someone who left years ago. You’ll be the first hire into the People team. For roughly your first year you’ll be the only People professional alongside the CPO, which means running the whole day-to-day of the function: the hardest casework and initiatives, and the operational core that keeps everything moving. A People Partner is planned to join later in 2027, and at that point the operational administration moves to them. This is also a role built with room to grow. As the team expands beyond that second hire, we expect this role to take on day-to-day operational leadership of the People Partner practice, but that isn’t the shape of it on day one. WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT In most People teams, the senior generalist is just a People Partner with a harder case queue. Here, the difference is ownership, not just difficulty. Complex casework: Rather than simply handling harder cases, you’ll own the most complex cases end to end, with no hand back. People initiatives: Rather than contributing to initiatives someone else drives, you’ll own them from design through to embedding. Decision-making: Rather than escalating ambiguity upward, you’ll make the sensible call and document your reasoning. CPO partnership: Rather than acting in a support role to the CPO, you’ll be an operational partner they can confidently delegate to. jobs.title: Broker Development Manager
jobs.description: About Flock Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time. We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead. We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us! About the role Brokers bring in nearly all of Flock’s business, so they’re central to how we grow. As a Broker Development Manager, you’ll look after a panel of key broker partners with real growth potential, deepen the relationships we already have and build new ones as we move into new sectors. You’ll report to our Head of Distribution. You’ll show brokers what our connected fleet proposition does for their clients: it cuts risk and cost and keeps drivers safer. We’re AI-first, so you’ll use AI every day to research brokers, prepare for meetings and spot opportunities across your panel, leaving more time for the conversations that win business. What you’ll be doing Be the main face of Flock for a panel of key broker partners and grow the business you do together. Drive a high volume of quality submissions from your panel. Grow the panel, onboarding new brokers quickly and getting them trading. Find new ways to promote Flock’s appetite and proposition as we expand into new sectors. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One +, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One+ , die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert. Mit Enpal.Cool bauen wir eine neue Abteilung für moderne Klima- und Energielösungen auf. Gesucht werden starke Sales Manager:innen im Raum Berlin/Brandenburg , die Lust haben, von Tag 1 an Verantwortung zu übernehmen und gemeinsam mit dem Team etwas Neues aufzubauen. Die Mission Das Verkaufstalent kommt zum Einsatz, um in jedem Gespräch durch Kompetenz und Überzeugungskraft aus vorqualifizierten Interessent:innen erfolgreiche Aufträge zu generieren. Dabei geht es nicht nur um den Verkauf eines Produkts: Die Lösungen verbessern die Lebensqualität von Menschen und machen ihre Energieversorgung zukunftsfähig. Der typische Tag Das Pre-Sales-Team stellt täglich vorqualifizierte Termine bereit. Strukturierte Abschlussgespräche werden eigenständig geführt und Kund:innen kompetent zur passenden Lösung begleitet. Follow-ups und „Baby Calls“ – also Gespräche zum Anwärmen und Aktivieren potenzieller Kund:innen – gehören ebenfalls zum Alltag. Ein modernes CRM-System sorgt für transparente Prozesse, effiziente Arbeitsabläufe und einen jederzeit guten Überblick über die Kund:innen. Die enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Vertriebsteam und die aktive Mitgestaltung der entstehenden Prozesse gehören zur Rolle. Das Team arbeitet eng zusammen und entwickelt die neue Abteilung mit viel Dynamik und echtem Start-up-Spirit. Das Profil Gesucht wird eine Person, die: Gespräche gezielt lenken und konzentriert auf einen erfolgreichen Abschlus

jobs.title: Customer Support Specialist (Danish Speaking)
jobs.description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together. What you’ll be doing As a Customer Support Senior Associate you will: Spend your time interacting directly with our customers over chat, email and phone, providing them with an effective, easy and enjoyable Pleo experience. Troubleshoot and resolve customers issues related to the Pleo product, and escalate to the appropriate internal team where needed. Provide feedback and support cross-functional teams on product development based on customer insights. Share learnings and contribute to our knowledge base to ensure growth and knowledge sharing across the team, and beyond. What you bring You’ll thrive in this role if you: Love providing fantastic, high-touch customer support on live chat, email and phone. Have a persistent and analytical approach to problem-solving. Are able to explain complicated problems in the simplest terms.

Dann unterstütze unser Marketing Team und gestalte gemeinsam mit uns die nächsten Schritte. Deine Aufgaben Du recherchierst und analysierst selbstständig potenzielle Kooperationspartner. Du übernimmst die Kontaktaufnahme mit potenziellen Partner und unterstützt bei der Verhandlung von Kooperationen. Das bringst Du mit Du bist aktuell als Student eingeschrieben und noch für mindestens zwölf Monate immatrikuliert. Du interessierst Dich für E-Commerce und Online-Marketing. Erste Erfahrungen im Content Marketing oder SEO sind ein Plus. Du denkst gerne über den Tellerrand hinaus, bringst eigene Ideen ein und findest kreative Lösungen für neue Herausforderungen. Du arbeitest dich schnell in neue Themen ein, gehst Aufgaben proaktiv an und kommunizierst gerne mit unterschiedlichen Ansprechpartner. jobs.title: Reliability Engineer (NL)
jobs.description: Functie Reliability engineer Beschrijving functie De reliability engineer is een productie specialist die de totale levensduur van installatie bestudeert en analyseert hoe het bedrijf omgaat met investeringen en onderhoud van assets. De reliability engineer is de expert in het identificeren van potentiële risico’s en het voorkomen van stilstanden. Daar problemen moeilijk volledig te voorkomen zijn, geeft de reliability engineer adviezen hoe te handelen bij storingen die plaatsvinden. Het doel is te voorkomen dat fouten in productiesystemen optreden. De reliability engineer analyseert tevens de veiligheidsrisico’s geassocieerd met installatie fouten. Ter voorkoming van stilstand maakt de reliability engineer onderhoudsschema’s en analyseert statistische gegevens die helpen te voorspellen wanneer en hoe fouten voor kunnen komen. De reliability engineer ontwikkelt inspectie criteria die gebruikt worden om de asset health te monitoren. Om dit te kunnen bereiken maakt de reliability engineer gebruik van een aantal technieken. Voorlopige gevaren analyse: Preliminary hazard analysis is de initiële identificatie van potentiële gevaren en fouten in een productie proces of systeem Failure modes and effect analysis ( FMEA): Betreft het opsommen van de manieren dat een proces of systeem kan falen en wat de consequenties hiervan zijn. Criticality analysis: bepaalt hoe ernstig de consequenties zijn van een asset fout voor het productiesysteem van het bedrijf. Onderhoudbaarheid: gedetailleerde informatie hoe efficiënt en betrouwbaar het bedrijf een onderdeel kan repareren. Foutenboom analyse: onderzoek van een systeem fout door naar de kleinere voorafgaande gebeurtenissen te kijken die hebben bijgedragen aan de systeem fout Taken Trouble shooting Faciliteren van root cause analyse in geval van complexe, multidisciplinaire afwijkingen/storingen waar de uitvoerende teams niet uitkomen Daily problem solving Continue verbeteren Periodieke analyse op performance killers en cost drivers

jobs.title: CENTRALE LYON - Post-doctoral researcher (12 months) Mathematics of energy-efficient AI: diffusion models on emerging hardware
jobs.description: The question Generating one image with a diffusion model means evaluating a large neural network tens to hundreds of times. That repetition is where the energy goes, and it is part of why data-centre demand is now visible at grid scale: the Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory puts US data-centre electricity use at 176 TWh in 2023, 4.4 % of national consumption, a figure that more than doubled since 2017 largely because of AI servers, and projects 325–580 TWh by 2028. Emerging hardware attacks exactly this primitive: analog in-memory computing, silicon photonics, ferroelectric devices and stochastic computing perform the underlying matrix–vector products at lower energy than digital CMOS, under conditions on scale and precision, but return a perturbed result. The usual objection is that nobody can say in advance how much perturbation a model tolerates. In EMMA, this opportunity is pursued through a PCM-based photonic matrix–vector engine as the primary demonstrator, complemented where appropriate by FeFET-based analog computing, so that device-level non-idealities are treated as explicit design parameters rather than as after-the-fact implementation losses. Diffusion models are an unusual case in which that question has a mathematical answer: their convergence theory bounds the discrepancy between the generated and target distributions by three terms, of which only one, the L 2 error of the learned score, depends on the hardware. That side is now in good shape: for stochastic samplers, bounds linear in the dimension under minimal assumptions on the data; for deterministic samplers, a matching theory under regularity. What is missing is the bridge. The theory is parameterised by a score error, the hardware literature by conductance noise, effective number of bits and photons per multiply–accumulate; nobody has written the map between them, in either direction. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books. The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving. We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome. The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. About the Role Ramp is scaling fast in the UK. Our European operations team (Europs) onboards UK and EU businesses across Ramp’s own regulated entities and our card-issuing and payments partners. We’re a small team of specialists that runs on frontier AI tooling. Everyone builds and maintains their own automations and apps, and we’ve taken daily processes from hours to minutes. We’re hiring a senior UK KYB expert to raise the bar on how we onboard UK businesses. You’ll work the hardest cases and make the final first-line call, own escalations with our partners, keep the UK queue moving, and build the fixes that stop the same problems coming back. This is a hands-on role for someone who would rather redesign a broken requirement than work around it, and who is as comfortable in a difficult ownership structure as in the data on why cases get stuck. What You'll Do Work the hardest UK onboarding cases yourself and make the final first-line (1LoD) call: complex ownership structures, EDD, PEP and adverse-media outcomes, and anything that needs judgement

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description: About Wayflyer Businesses come to Wayflyer to get the capital they need to grow. When they apply, connect their data or upload documents, every screen, word and transition either builds their trust or loses it. We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer with exceptional craft, strong product instincts and a builder mentality to shape how they access and manage capital. You will take financial workflows and information-rich experiences from first idea to shipped product, and make them feel intuitive and trustworthy. As part of our fully remote team of 15 designers across Product, Brand, Motion, and Design. Systems, you’ll collaborate across disciplines, share a common design system, and challenge each other’s work through open critiques, always pushing the quality of our craft forward. How we think about craft Craft is for the customer. Design should improve experiences, not just appearances. Execution matters. From pixels to micro-interactions, nothing should feel accidental. Trust is built through details . Especially when making decisions about their money. Quality is a choice we make every day. It is not a final polish step or a handoff. Speed and quality go together. We ship early, learn from real use and keep improving. You can't write quality into a spec. It comes from people who care and who build. Who Thrives Here You don't wait for perfect requirements. You define the problem first. You balance customer needs, business goals and technical limits. You believe simplifying is one of the hardest and most valuable design skills. You care deeply about craft and know that details matter. You know that trust in financial products is built through hundreds of small interactions. You push back when it matters, for the customer and for quality. You use AI to explore, prototype and improve your work. You thrive in a fast-moving team. What You'll Actually Do Own complex financial problems from discovery to delivery, and turn dense data into clear, scalable experiences.

jobs.title: M&A Associate (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Über die Rolle Eine gute Kaufentscheidung beginnt damit, dass jemand genau hinsieht. Bei Buena bist du das: Du verstehst das Unternehmen, hinterfragst Annahmen, erkennst Risiken und begründest, welchen Preis wir zahlen sollten. Du verantwortest die Due Diligence für Hausverwaltungen, die wir übernehmen möchten: von der ersten Sichtung des Datenraums über die Bewertung und die Präsentation im Investment Committee bis zu den finanziellen und operativen Anlagen für den Kaufvertrag. Wenn das Committee ins Detail geht, kennst du das Unternehmen und kannst deine Empfehlung fundiert begründen. Unser Prozess steht. Jetzt suchen wir jemanden, der die Verantwortung für die Qualität der Analysen übernimmt, die Due Diligence eigenständig steuert und unseren Prozess mit dem Wachstum weiterentwickelt. Über Buena Buena übernimmt Hausverwaltungen und digitalisiert sie mit selbst entwickelter Software. Wir verbinden Akquisitionen, operative Erfahrung und Technologie, um Immobilieneigentum und Verwaltung einfacher zu machen. M&A ist ein zentraler Teil dieser Strategie. Die Unternehmen, die wir kaufen, werden Teil von Buena. Deshalb zählt unser Verständnis ihrer Zahlen, Verträge, Teams und Abläufe weit über den Abschluss einer Transaktion hinaus. Deine Verantwortung Das Unternehmen hinter dem Datenraum verstehen. Du führst Finanzdaten, Verträge, Objektlisten und Mitarbeiterinformationen zusammen. Du erkennst Lücken, gehst Widersprüchen nach und klärst offene Fragen mit den Verkäufern, bis ein belastbares Gesamtbild entsteht. Die Bewertung fundiert herleiten. Du analysierst die wirtschaftliche Entwicklung, arbeitest mit unseren Kaufpreismodellen und prüfst die zugrunde liegenden Annahmen. Du zeigst, was deine Erkenntnisse für den Kaufpreis und die Investitionsentscheidung bedeuten. Deine Ergebnisse im Investment Committee vertreten. Du verdichtest die Due Diligence zu einer klaren Einschätzung von Chancen, Risiken und offenen Fragen und präsentierst sie direkt vor den Entscheidungsträg

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - (AI x Greentech) (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Make Everything Just Work Most jobs ask you to keep the lights on. This one asks you to build the machine that keeps an entire company and its customers running. At Reonic, we’re building the AI operating system for renewable installers, with competitive pay, growth opportunities and a strong culture based on ambition, impact and ownership. And we’re doing it fast. As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you’re where our product meets the real world. You work hands-on with renewable energy installers and their technical teams, help them build on our API, and solve the problems that stand between them and a setup that just works. Around 80% of your time is spent with customers. The other 20% goes to making Reonic itself run the way an AI-first company should. What you'll do With our customers (~80%) Enable our API users: Work with customers’ technical teams as they build on our API and webhooks. Review their approach, answer the tricky questions and get them unblocked fast. Solve problems end to end: When something breaks, you find out why. Reproduce the issue, work with engineering on the fix and keep the customer in the loop until it’s solved. Connect Reonic to their world: Make Reonic work seamlessly with the tools our customers rely on every day, from Microsoft and Google to their CRM, accounting and automation platforms. Make customers self-sufficient: Write guides, examples and snippets that help customers help themselves. Inside Reonic (~20%) Run our AI tools: Own our Claude and ChatGPT workspaces, from access and connectors to costs. Make AI part of everyone’s job: Help colleagues build integrations, connectors and automations that save them real time. Own our IT setup: Keep our tools, devices and security running smoothly, so everyone at Reonic can do their best work from day one. jobs.title: GTM Intern - New Products (AI x Greentech) (m/f/d)
jobs.description: You turn new ideas into revenue at Reonic. Find the opportunity, test it, make it happen. Looking for a role where you don't just support growth but actually own it? This is for you. You'll work directly with installers to uncover real problems, turn those insights into new products and services, and take them from first idea to go-to-market. Working closely with our Venture Development team, you'll have the freedom and responsibility to figure out what works - and the pace to make it happen. Please note that for this role, C2 German proficiency is required. This is a full-time, on-site position based in Berlin. What You’ll Do Go-to-market for new products and services inside our software. Which installers need this service? How do we reach them? What can we charge? What are the selling points? You don't find the answers at your desk, you find them by trying things. Customer immersion and spotting new revenue streams. Daily conversations with installers to find out where their processes really hurt, pressure-test ideas against reality, and sell what you've built together with the Venture Development team. Commercial responsibility. You figure out which model works: commission, fixed price, bundled pricing, or a partner share. And you see early whether a channel has enough potential to keep pushing. Cross-functional execution. You pull sales, marketing, tech, and external partners together around your topic and keep it moving. You're the one who calls the next step and makes sure it happens. What Makes You a Great Fit Native or C2-level German and fluent English. You've already brought something to market, or at least tried: your own project, a campaign, a product during an internship. What matters isn't the outcome, it's that you got going. Strong sense of ownership and impatient if things don't move fast. You'd rather talk to customers than build a theory at your desk. jobs.title: Copy Editor English
jobs.description: Hi, we’re AMBOSS and we’re searching for a Copy Editor to join our team of English language experts for 14-18 months and help shape the language that medical professionals around the world rely on. About AMBOSS AMBOSS is the copilot for medical professionals, empowering them to provide the best possible care through our learning and clinical decision support tool. Our team brings together care, innovative thinking, and cutting-edge AI medical technology. Our founders launched AMBOSS in 2012 with the goal of creating a tool they wished they had during medical school and clinical practice. Since then, we’ve grown to over 600 employees and are active in over 180 countries - primarily in Germany and the US. Our offices are located in Berlin, Cologne, New York, Cagliari and Cape Town. Want to learn more about our culture? Watch our video to explore what makes us unique. Why can this position be exciting for you? Your work will shape the language that medical students, clinicians, and educators rely on, from exam prep to the point of care. You’ll edit articles and Qbanks for different markets and work side by side with our medical editors. Together, you’ll keep our content clear, correct, and consistent as it grows. You’ll also build and test AI tools and prompts that raise the language quality of everything we publish. If you love both the art of language and the language of medicine, we’d be delighted to meet you. jobs.description: À propos d’Exotec Nous concevons et déployons des solutions d'automatisation d'entrepôt logistique, associant robotique, logiciels et expertise opérationnelle. En tant que fabricant et intégrateur de référence, nous accompagnons certaines des marques les plus emblématiques au monde dans leur transition vers l'automatisation. Nous sommes fiers de concevoir des technologies qui ne se contentent pas de transformer l'intralogistique : elles rendent également les entrepôts plus sûrs, plus performants et moins éprouvants pour les personnes qui y travaillent. Votre rôle Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recherchons un(e) Tech Talent Acquisition Partner en CDD de 12 mois pour renforcer notre équipe Talent Acquisition. Vous interviendrez sur un périmètre stratégique couvrant les métiers R&D, Product et IT , avec des recrutements majoritairement basés en France. Véritable partenaire des équipes opérationnelles, vous les accompagnerez dans l'identification, l'attraction et le recrutement des talents qui contribuent à concevoir et développer nos solutions robotiques et logicielles dédiées à l'automatisation des entrepôts et à l'optimisation des flux logistiques. Dans un environnement dynamique et en constante évolution, vous prendrez en charge l'ensemble du processus de recrutement, de la définition du besoin jusqu'à l'intégration des candidats. Votre capacité à créer une relation de confiance avec les managers, à identifier les bons profils et à faire avancer les processus de recrutement sera essentielle pour réussir dans ce rôle. Basé(e) à Lille, vous serez rattaché(e) au Talent Acquisition Manager et travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes RH et les autres membres de l'équipe Talent Acquisition, dans un environnement international. Vos missions Piloter les processus de recrutement de bout en bout sur votre périmètre R&D, Product et IT, de la prise de brief avec les managers jusqu'à la gestion des offres et l'intégration des candidats. jobs.title: Intern Data Analyst - Paris
jobs.description: Qui sommes-nous ? Fondée en 2014, Artefact est une société française de services autour de la data, spécialisée dans le conseil en IA, transformation data et en data & digital marketing. L’approche unique d’Artefact, qui fait le pont entre la donnée et le business, permet à nos clients d’atteindre leurs objectifs business de façon dédiée et efficace. Nos 2500 collaborateurs répartis dans 27 bureaux à travers le monde allient leurs compétences pluridisciplinaires au profit de l’innovation business des entreprises. La mission des Artefactors ? Transformer la data de nos clients en impact business. Dans ce sens, nous collaborons avec plus de 1000 clients, leaders de leurs industries (Orange, Carrefour, Samsung, AccorHotels, L’Oréal, LVMH, Decathlon) et sommes partenaires privilégiés de Google (GMP/GCP), AWS ainsi que Microsoft Azure. En tant que stagiaire Data Analyst, tu seras intégré(e) à une équipe travaillant étroitement avec des consultants / data scientists et tu participeras à des missions ayant un impact réel pour les clients. Tes missions pourront inclure : Collecter, nettoyer, préparer les données à partir de sources diverses (bases de données internes, API, logs, etc.). Explorer et analyser les données pour identifier tendances, anomalies, corrélations, patterns utiles. Participer à la conception et réalisation de dashboards / reportings sous outils de data visualisation (ex. Tableau, PowerBI, ou outils internes) pour présenter les résultats aux équipes ou aux clients. Contribuer à la définition de KPI pertinents selon les objectifs métier. Travailler en collaboration avec les équipes métier (marketing, produit, etc.) pour bien comprendre leurs besoins et transformer ces besoins en analyses exploitables. Aider à automatiser certains processus de reporting ou analyses simples. Documenter tes travaux, partager les résultats et les apprentissages au sein de l’équipe, proposer des améliorations ou de nouvelles approches quand c’est possible. Profil recherché

jobs.title: CDI - AI Designer  Motion & Génératif  - Artefact 3000 - Paris
jobs.description: QUI SOMMES-NOUS  Artefact 3000 est l’agence créative intégrée d’Artefact qui combine le talent créatif au savoir-faire data & IA. L’agence puise son inspiration dans le réel et les insights précis pour concevoir des idées qui résonnent et marquent les esprits sur tous les terrains de jeu créatifs, de l’IA aux médias intemporels.  Basée à Paris, Artefact 3000 compte 65 collaborateurs et accompagne ses clients dans la définition de leur stratégie de communication, la conception et le déploiement de campagnes intégrées, l’animation des réseaux sociaux, et la production digitale (contenus, expériences digitales, sites web). MISSIONS Dans ce rôle, tu es en charge de la production de contenus visuels et vidéo en IA générative , sous la direction d un créatif tech senior et en collaboration direct avec un autre créatif. La majorité de ton activité consiste à exécuter des briefs créatifs avec des outils IA, en garantissant la qualité et la cohérence des livrables finaux. Production IA (cœur du poste) Produire des contenus image et vidéo avec des outils IA génératifs (Midjourney, Runway, Kling, Higgsfield,, etc.) selon des briefs créatifs précis. Assurer la post-production et l intégration des assets IA dans des livrables finaux (montage, compositing, motion). Motion design & exécution créative Produire des contenus vidéo en motion design (After Effects, Premiere Pro). Décliner des concepts visuels validés sur les formats de campagne 360 (social, display, film digital, OOH). Contribuer à l élaboration de moodboards et key visuals en amont de production. PROFIL Expérience Diplômé(e) d une école de Design (design graphique ou motion design) ou avec une première expérience professionnelle en agence.  Un portfolio avec des productions IA concrètes est obligatoire ; les candidatures sans livrables IA ne seront pas examinées. Compétences techniques indispensables Maîtrise indispensable de la Suite Adobe : After Effects, Premiere Pro, Photoshop et Illustrator

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Intern
jobs.description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. jobs.title: Sr. Engineering Manager - Developer Ecosystem
jobs.description: RDQ427R369 At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world s toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world s best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Our Developer Ecosystem organisation shapes how developers and the AI agents working for them build on the Databricks Data and AI Platform, from within the product to the tools they already use. We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead our declarative deployment framework, which turns data and AI projects into versioned, reviewable, repeatable software. It is one product with two entry points. Third-party developers use our open-source CLI from their IDEs, terminals, and CI/CD systems. First-party, they author, deploy and inspect the same projects inside the Databricks workspace. In both, AI agents increasingly do the work: coding agents drive the CLI, and our in-product AI assistant authors and deploys projects alongside the developer. Thousands of organisations run their CI/CD on it, and it is one of the fastest-growing parts of the platform. The team owns the deployment engine and CLI, the in-workspace authoring and deployment experience, and the metadata service and deployment history that record every deployment. The hard problems are real infrastructure-as-code problems: reconciling declared and live state, making plans safe for humans and agents to approve, keeping visual authoring and code in sync, and shipping weekly releases that remain backwards-compatible for our largest customers. The impact you will have: Lead and grow the team: Manage a team of senior engineers across three closely connected areas (the deployment engine and open-source CLI, the in-workspace authoring and deployment experience, and deployment history and metadata), working with strong tech leads. Geen koffie halen of papierwerk, jij duikt samen met onze projectleider in de praktijk van energietransitie en energie-armoede. Of het nu gaat om het uitvoeren van inspecties of meedenken over interventies: jij maakt impact. Dit wordt jouw stage Wil jij meedenken over een maatschappelijk vraagstuk dat steeds urgenter wordt? Tijdens deze stage duik je in het thema energiearmoede: wat is het precies, waar speelt het en wat betekent dit voor ons als organisatie? Je werkt op het snijvlak van sociaal en technisch en helpt ons om richting te bepalen: hoe kunnen wij hierop inspelen? Je werkt mee binnen één van onze teams en wordt begeleid door een ervaren collega. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen én om echt impact te maken. Op dit moment hebben wij één afstudeerstageplek rondom het thema energietransitie en energie-armoede Wat ga je doen? Je gaat onderzoeken wat energiearmoede inhoudt en hoe dit zich uit in de praktijk, met name in stedelijke gebieden zoals Amsterdam waar veel (sociale) huurwoningen zijn. Je houdt je bezig met: Het in kaart brengen van wat energiearmoede betekent; Inzicht krijgen in waar het speelt en welke doelgroepen geraakt worden; Gesprekken voeren met corporaties en marktpartijen (interviews, ophalen van ervaringen en data); Onderzoeken welke oplossingen er zijn, zoals passief bouwen, minder installaties of slimme energieoplossingen; Vertalen van jouw inzichten naar een duidelijke visie: waar moeten wij ons op richten en hoe kunnen wij hierop inspelen? Het gaat hierbij niet om de techniek alleen, maar juist om de combinatie van sociale impact, marktontwikkelingen en strategie. Built on Microsoft Fabric, it brings together data from our different systems, and it serves the reporting and data agents that production, supply chain, program management, and finance work from every week. jobs.description: Your role As our CMO Partner Manager (all genders), you will serve as the strategic interface between our internal teams (R&D, Quality, Operations) and external manufacturing partners. You will own your product categories end-to-end - securing product availability, driving cost efficiency, and leveraging external manufacturing intelligence to spark innovation within our supply chain. Drive Security of Supply: Guarantee product availability and eliminate stockouts through proactive risk management, robust capacity planning, and flawless data tracking (ETAs). Manage & Scale Partner Networks: Continuously screen the market for new manufacturing capabilities, onboard strategic CMO partners, and manage day-to-day partner operations. Optimize TCO & Commercials: Build deep market insight into raw material and manufacturing costs to negotiate optimal pricing, terms, and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO). Drive Launch Execution: Direct New Product Introductions (NPI) from concept to market launch, ensuring cross-functional and partner alignment to meet project timelines. Champion Quality & Efficiency: Hold partners accountable to strict delivery reliability (OTIF) and swift quality resolution (CAPA), while bringing external best practices back to internal operations. Your profile Background & Experience: 5+ years in strategic procurement, category management, or contract manufacturing (CMO) - ideally in dietary supplements, FMCG, food, or pharma. Experience in complex batch manufacturing is a strong plus. Strategic & Commercial Acumen: You understand how procurement drives value beyond unit price - leveraging TCO models, raw material cost structures, and smart negotiations to optimize margins. Project & Stakeholder Management: Proven track record of leading complex, cross-functional initiatives (e.g., NPIs). En.....ben je die R&D engineer die helpt civiele en militaire vliegtuigen veilig, duurzaam en competitief te laten vliegen? Door aan vliegtuigen te meten en te testen om alles te weten te komen? Wil jij jezelf verder ontwikkelen en word je enthousiast van techniek, innovatie, veiligheid en duurzaamheid? Dan spreken we je graag! Wat ga je doen? Als Senior R&D engineer Flight Test en Certificatie werk je mee aan het veiliger, duurzamer en competitiever maken van de militaire en civiele luchtvaart. Je werkt aan vliegtuigen, helikopters en onbemande vliegende systemen. Om onze binnen- en buitenlandse opdrachtgevers te ondersteunen in het bereiken van hun doelen voer je testen uit en analyseert de resultaten, je toetst wijzigingen aan vliegtuigen aan de regelgeving in het kader van veilig vliegen en je ontwikkelt nieuwe regelgeving om innovatieve technieken te implementeren. Je bedenkt en werkt aan innovatieve oplossingen samen met collega’s en andere R&D instituten in een (inter-) nationale setting. Je leidt projecten, hebt veel klantcontact (intern en extern) en werkt met zelfsturende teams, in wisselende samenstelling. Je voert projectwerk uit, je coördineert werkpakketten en je initieert met je collega’s nieuwe projecten. Het werken bij Koninklijke NLR kenmerkt zich door variatie en dynamische werkverbanden. Onze missie is om nieuwe technologie praktisch en veilig toepasbaar te maken en daarmee de Nederlandse (en Europese) industrie en overheid te helpen om voorop te lopen. We geven goed onderbouwde adviezen aan beleidsbepalers, ontwikkelaars en gebruikers. Wat breng je mee? Afgeronde WO master in een technische richting zoals luchtvaarttechniek, elektrotechniek of informatica; Tenminste 5 jaren relevante werkervaring; Ontwikkeling van lucht- en ruimtevaarttuigen en klimaat neutrale luchtvaart spreken je aan als werkgebieden; De ambitie om expert te worden op het gebied van flight tes

Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one. Customers and users across the globe use Planet s data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles. As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains. We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world. Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands. As a Senior Space Systems Engineer on this team you will own the definition of novel concepts of operations. jobs.description: The opportunity Tax advisory has everything automation needs: structured data, recurring work, clear rules. Yet the profession never made the leap, because recurring does not mean uniform. Every case has its own twist, and the law keeps moving. Reasoning resolves exactly this variance. That is why the window is open now. The model is no longer the scarce part. Expert knowledge and real case data are, and AI labs pay a premium for exactly this. Vogel holds what no AI-native player has: decades of accounting data, edge cases and judgment calls from several thousand mid-sized companies, audited and closed. It never leaves the house, and it becomes the edge of what you build. The market is being reordered: four in ten tax advisors in Germany leave the profession within ten years, and many of their firms will find no successor. Vogel acquires established advisory firms and develops them further, and every acquisition adds to that base. We have already produced our own annual financial statements with AI. Today, that is one person with a tool. Turning it into a capability of the whole company is the job. You own the technology that makes Vogel AI-first: the data layer above DATEV, the agent infrastructure on top, and the control layer without which nothing in this profession may go live. You decide the architecture and the stack of what we build. What it does and in which order is decided together with Operations and Moritz Vogel in the role of chief product officer, close to the advisors who use it; you shape it with them. You report to and work directly with Moritz Vogel. What you'll do Architecture above DATEV Build the data layer above DATEV. DATEV stays the system of record (for now); the value is created in the layer above it, designed to outlive the system beneath. Krijg jij energie van het doorgronden van complexe productieprocessen en weet je deze te vertalen naar slimme, innovatieve softwareoplossingen? Wil jij de vrijheid krijgen om initiatief te nemen, richting te geven aan productontwikkeling en écht impact te maken binnen een internationale, dynamische organisatie? Dan is dit jouw kans! LogicSteel is ons cloud-based software platform voor de staalverwerkende industrie. Middels LogicSteel wordt de ontwerpfase, werkvoorbereiding en productie naadloos met elkaar verbonden. Wat kunnen klanten uit LogicSteel halen? Denk bijvoorbeeld aan het automatisch plannen en inkopen van al het materiaal voor productie, het optimaliseren van het proces voor nesting op basis van voorraad en beschikbaarheid, het realtime volgen van het volledige productieproces én het aansturen van onze machines. jobs.title: Senior Visual Designer
jobs.description: At Dyflexis, we help millions of employees worldwide with our workforce management software. From the bakery around the corner to international hotel and retail chains. The software is powerful, customer questions are diverse, and no two days are the same. You'll get to know the product inside out and contribute to something that's growing rapidly in more than 20 countries. How do we do it? We work in a fast-paced environment with short communication lines. There are no unnecessary meetings and no politics. Our Focus? Ownership, clear communication, and getting things done together. We move quickly, learn by doing, and continuously improve how we support our customers. As our Senior Visual Designer, you'll take our visual identity and our website to the next level, and help build a brand that matches our ambitions. Nothing is set in stone, and there's a lot we want to build. This is what you'll do Your work is often the first thing a hotel chain or a bakery sees of us, usually on a screen: our website, a campaign, a landing page. You'll shape how Dyflexis looks and feels everywhere and take the brand from consistent to unmistakable. You'll work closely with our Brand Designer, the Marketing team, and UX/UI colleagues. You bring creative ideas, design thinking and a strong eye for digital. You turn business goals into concepts, carry one strong idea through every touchpoint, and know how to win people over with your work. Take our visual identity further: typography, colour, imagery, illustration and motion, into a bold language that works in every market and language we're in. Bring dyflexis.com to the next level: layouts, landing pages and the visual side of the user journey, together with the Product team. Design campaigns, social, ads, landing pages and sales materials that are on brand and on point. You keep the brand sharp in the everyday work, and you make it better every time. Turn business goals into creative concepts and help shape where the brand goes next

jobs.title: Junior Tester
jobs.description: Ben jij nieuwsgierig naar hoe software werkt en vind je het leuk om uit te zoeken of alles doet wat het zou moeten doen? Heb je oog voor detail, stel je graag kritische vragen en krijg je energie van het vinden van verbeterpunten? Dan is deze functie als Junior Tester precies wat je zoekt! Als tester speel je een belangrijke rol in de kwaliteit van software. Je onderzoekt applicaties, voert testen uit en kijkt kritisch naar de werking ervan. Kom je iets tegen wat niet klopt? Dan analyseer je wat er aan de hand is en zorg je ervoor dat jouw bevindingen duidelijk bij de juiste mensen terechtkomen. Je hoeft nog geen ervaring te hebben als tester. We vinden het vooral belangrijk dat je leergierig, analytisch en nauwkeurig bent en graag wilt ontdekken hoe je software steeds beter kunt maken. Wat ga je doen als Junior Tester? Als Junior Tester houd je je bezig met het controleren en beoordelen van de werking en kwaliteit van applicaties en systemen. Je werkt samen met ontwikkelaars, analisten en andere betrokken collega's om ervoor te zorgen dat software goed functioneert en voldoet aan de verwachtingen. Je leert stap voor stap hoe je verschillende soorten testen uitvoert en hoe je bevindingen op een duidelijke manier rapporteert. Concreet zijn jouw werkzaamheden: Opstellen van testscenario's Uitvoeren van testgevallen Controleren of applicaties werken zoals bedoeld Signaleren van fouten, afwijkingen en verbeterpunten Analyseren van testresultaten en bevindingen Registreren en duidelijk communiceren van bevindingen Samenwerken met developers, analisten en andere stakeholders Meedenken over de kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid van software Leren werken met verschillende testmethodieken en tools Je krijgt gedurende het traineeship de ruimte om praktijkervaring op te doen en steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Zo groei je stap voor stap van trainee naar een zelfstandige tester. Binnen het traineeship Business & IT ontwikkel je jezelf in twee jaar tijd tot een echte IT-prof

Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist. We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1.5B+ before its acquisition by OptumRx). Â The Opportunity Everything we run today is cloud-based, and so are the pharmacy management systems we integrate with. But most of the specialty pharmacy market runs on-prem. jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent
